integrity: The claim is derived directly from the printed differential equations by an exact Dulac-weight differentiation and Green's theorem; numerical phase portraits are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Necessary condition only: it does not prove existence, uniqueness, stability, period, or detailed shape of a periodic orbit.
Restricted to nonconstant periodic orbits contained in the positive quadrant and to positive cooperative-hunting strength.
Does not classify nonperiodic recurrent invariant sets.
title: Exact area-harmonic-mean law for every positive limit cycle in a fear–cooperation predator–prey model
